Rice.why_suitable: Warm humid climate and heavy water availability provide optimal conditions for high-tillering paddy cultivars.
farming_tips: Maintain 3-5 cm standing water layer during early tillering stage.
Apply balanced NPK along with basal dose of Zinc Sulfate (25 kg/ha).
Scout regularly for stem borer and leaf folder during vegetative stage.

Wheat.why_suitable: Cool vegetative temperatures and well-aerated fertile soils favor robust tillering and dense grain filling.
farming_tips: Ensure crown root initiation (CRI) irrigation within 21 days of sowing.
Split nitrogen application into two equal doses at 1st and 2nd irrigation.
Monitor for yellow rust symptoms in cool, humid morning weather.

Maize.why_suitable: Deep, well-drained loam and warm daytime temperatures promote rapid biomass development and high cob yield.
farming_tips: Ensure proper field drainage furrows to prevent waterlogging.
Apply adequate potassium to reinforce stalk strength against lodging.
Scout early for Fall Armyworm in whorls during initial 30 days.

Sugarcane.why_suitable: Rich nutrient reserves, abundant sunlight, and sustained moisture enable exceptional cane tonnage and sugar recovery.
farming_tips: Practice trash mulching between rows to conserve soil moisture.
Treat setts with fungicide before planting to prevent red rot.
Perform earthing-up in the 3rd to 4th month to prevent cane lodging.

Cotton(lint).why_suitable: Deep fertile loam and warm growing season support steady boll formation and high lint quality.
farming_tips: Install pheromone traps (5/acre) to monitor pink bollworm.
Spray 2% DAP foliar solution at peak flowering to reduce boll shedding.
Maintain clean weed-free conditions during the first 60 days.

Potato.why_suitable: Cool night temperatures and loose, potassium-rich soil allow rapid tuber bulking and smooth skin finish.
farming_tips: Perform timely earthing up to prevent greening of developing tubers.
Maintain uniform light irrigations at 7 to 10 day intervals.
Apply preventive Mancozeb spray against early and late blight.

Groundnut.why_suitable: Light friable sandy loam with good drainage allows easy peg penetration and uniform pod development.
farming_tips: Apply Gypsum @ 200 kg/acre at pegging stage to boost pod filling and oil content.
Inoculate seeds with Rhizobium culture prior to planting.
Avoid heavy water stagnation during flowering and pod development.

Moong(Green Gram).why_suitable: Short crop duration and natural nitrogen fixation make it an excellent choice for rotation and soil enrichment.
farming_tips: Treat seeds with Rhizobium and Trichoderma before sowing.
Provide one irrigation at flowering and another at pod development.
Spray bio-pesticides early to manage whitefly and yellow mosaic virus.

Urad.why_suitable: Thrives in warm conditions, replenishing soil nitrogen while delivering high protein grain yields.
farming_tips: Ensure well-drained seedbed to protect against root rot during heavy rains.
Apply phosphorus as basal fertilizer to support strong nodulation.
Protect against pod borer attacks during early morning flowering.

Sesamum.why_suitable: Remarkable drought resilience and minimal nutrient demand make it highly remunerative in dry seasons.
farming_tips: Maintain thin spacing (10-15 cm) to allow ample lateral branching.
Avoid excess water application to prevent phyllody and root rot.
Harvest when bottom capsules turn yellow to avoid pod shattering.

Rapeseed &Mustard.why_suitable: Crisp winter weather and modest irrigation requirements yield high oil percentage and rich harvest.
farming_tips: Apply Sulfur (20 kg/ha) at field preparation to increase seed oil content.
Ensure first irrigation at 30-35 days (rosette stage).
Keep ready aphid control measures during cloudy winter spells in January.

Bajra.why_suitable: High heat and drought tolerance make pearl millet ideal for arid and semi-arid conditions.
farming_tips: Sow after onset of first monsoon showers in well-drained soil.
Top-dress nitrogen 30 days after sowing following intercultivation.
Ensure bird scaring during grain dough and maturity stage.

Jowar.why_suitable: Exceptional drought recovery and sturdy root system ensure steady fodder and grain production.
farming_tips: Maintain plant spacing of 45 cm between rows for optimal sunlight interception.
Monitor for shoot fly attack during the initial 4-week window.
Apply balanced fertilization to enhance dual-purpose grain and stover yield.

Gram.why_suitable: Nitrogen-fixing chickpea thrives in residual moisture, requiring minimal irrigation while enriching soil.
farming_tips: Perform seed treatment with Carbendazim + Rhizobium culture.
Nip terminal shoots at 30-40 days to promote profuse branching.
Install T-shaped bird perches across field for natural pod borer control.

Arhar/Tur.why_suitable: Deep taproot system tolerates prolonged dry spells while adding massive organic nitrogen to soil.
farming_tips: Adopt ridge and furrow planting method to prevent wilt from waterlogging.
Spray Neem oil or Emamectin Benzoate at 50% flowering to deter pod borers.
Intercrop with short-duration soybean or green gram for higher return.

Onion.why_suitable: Friable soil and cool vegetative climate ensure tight bulb formation and extended storage life.
farming_tips: Transplant 6-7 week old sturdy seedlings into raised beds.
Provide regular light irrigations and stop watering 10 days before harvest.
Cure harvested bulbs in shade for 7-10 days before storage.

Sunflower.why_suitable: Photo-insensitive crop adaptable across seasons with deep root moisture extraction capacity.
farming_tips: Hand pollination or placing bee hives improves seed setting significantly.
Apply Boron foliar spray (0.2%) at ray floret opening stage.
Protect heads from parrot and bird damage during seed ripening.

Soyabean.why_suitable: High oil and protein content crop thriving in well-drained loam during warm monsoonal conditions.
farming_tips: Inoculate seed with Bradyrhizobium japonicum before sowing.
Maintain adequate drainage to prevent collar rot in heavy rain.
Apply pre-emergence herbicide within 48 hours of sowing for weed control.

Ragi.why_suitable: Nutrient-dense finger millet with superior climate resilience and adaptability to varied soil profiles.
farming_tips: Transplant 21-day seedlings in rows for higher tillering.
Incorporate farmyard manure to enhance water retention in lighter soils.
Harvest when earheads turn distinct brown.

Banana.why_suitable: High organic carbon and warm humid conditions yield heavy bunches with superior fruit sweetness.
farming_tips: Use virus-free tissue culture plantlets for uniform maturity.
Provide drip fertigation with high potassium during fruit development.
Prop plants with bamboo poles to support heavy bunches against strong winds.

Coconut.why_suitable: Coastal and humid tropical agro-climates deliver maximum nut yield and copra content.
farming_tips: Apply organic mulch and coir pith in the basin around palm trunks.
Supply balanced NPK and Magnesium Sulfate twice annually.
Install pheromone traps for rhinoceros beetle management.

Arecanut.why_suitable: High rainfall tropical valleys with deep well-drained soil produce premier grade arecanut harvest.
farming_tips: Provide proper shade for young seedlings during first 3 years.
Spray Bordeaux mixture 1% before monsoon to prevent fruit rot (Koleroga).
Adopt intercropping with black pepper or cocoa for diversified income.

farming_tips: Use certified high-yielding seeds of Castor seed suited to regional conditions.
Maintain recommended spacing and basal NPK application at sowing.
Scout field weekly for pest symptoms and ensure weed-free initial growth.
